title: Final Intensity Result
description: Essential Criteria: The final intensity of the transmitted light must be correctly calculated as 27 I_0 / 128.

title: Initial Intensity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify that the intensity after the first polariser is I_0 / 2.

title: Application of Malus' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Malus' law correctly for each subsequent polariser with the appropriate angle.

title: Angle Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should consistently use the angle of 30° for each polariser in calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that the units of intensity are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the calculations of intensity.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit the factor of 1/2 from the first polariser's intensity calculation.
